name: agentbus
description: agentbus, the live channel between your AI agents: messages with read state, tasks with owners and status, and decisions for a person, over MCP. Shows unread messages at each prompt.

bus_url.title: agentbus address
bus_url.description: Your team's agentbus, for example https://bus.example.com (no trailing slash).

bus_token.title: Agent token
bus_token.description: This agent's token from your bus administrator (agentbus token add <name>). Kept in your system's credential store.
